item.title: ABC News: NSW hold on for epic draw against Queensland
item.description: Thanks to a sporting declaration by Queensland and some exceptional bowling, the SCG was treated to one of the best Sheffield Shield finishes in years as New South Wales hung on for a draw.

item.title: ABC News: Rethink of NT social worker recruitment urged amid 'alarming' staffing data
item.description: The winner of the NT's best social worker award has called for a rethink of how the sector recruits and retains staff following new figures showing 43 per cent of child protection positions are vacant.

item.title: ABC News: Inquest into baby deaths hears 'birth keeper' had no medical training
item.description: An inquest hears a "birth keeper" had no formal qualifications and "never carried oxygen" during her 23-year career.

item.title: ABC News: Drug driver jailed for 14 years after double fatality
item.description: North Queensland man Michael John Pomeroy pleaded guilty to the manslaughter of Christopher and Dorothy Bridges.

item.title: ABC News: NSW regional and interstate trains could be offline for a week from Friday
item.description: NSW regional and interstate passenger train services are set to be suspended for a week due to industrial action, with the rail network operator warning major disruptions to freight services will also affect supply chains.

item.title: ABC News: Fire damages car wreckers, causes commuter chaos in Melbourne's west
item.description: Commuters have been advised to allow an extra 45 minutes for their journey, with buses partially replacing trains.

item.title: ABC News: Construction underway on temporary transmission towers for Eyre Peninsula
item.description: Four temporary towers will be installed on the state's Eyre Peninsula, to bring transmission services back to the region after storm activity last week.

item.title: ABC News: Door not closed on capital gains carve-out for businesses as inquiry confirmed
item.description: Allegra Spender's proposal to carve out all active businesses and business assets from Labor's capital gains tax changes could yet succeed, with the carve-outs issue to be referred to a Senate inquiry.

item.title: ABC News: Six dead after small plane crashes off Mississippi coast
item.description: The bodies of those on board, including two boys aged 8 and 10, have been recovered by the US Coast Guard after the plane went down in the Gulf of Mexico.

item.title: ABC News: 18-year-old denied bail over fatal stabbing in Melbourne CBD
item.description: The court heard Peter Hlawnchan was a key support for his mother, who has cancer.

item.title: ABC News: Breaking: Khawaja offers Sandpapergate peace proposal
item.description: Usman Khawaja reveals he proposed a peace statement to Cricket Australia CEO Todd Greenberg in the hope of ending the war of words tearing Australian cricket apart in relation to Sandpapergate.

item.title: ABC News: Queensland and Canberra clash over environmental law review 'stunt'
item.description: Federal environment minister Murray Watt says Queensland is "no longer the smart state, it's the slow state" as a stoush erupts over environmental laws.

item.title: ABC News: Court battle over dumped Vic Liberal candidate's use of blue t-shirts
item.description: Victorian Labor alleges dumped Liberal-turned-independent candidate for Williamstown Paul Lindemann is deliberately trying to mislead voters by using of blue on his election promotional material.
